subject: sounds
title: Hard or Soft c and g
about: The letters c and g each make two sounds: hard c says /k/ (cat, cold, cup) and soft c says /s/ (city, cereal), hard g says /g/ (goat, gum) and soft g says /j/ (gem, giant), and the soft sound usually comes when e, i or y is next. CKLA Units 5 and 6 call c and g tricky spellings; knowing which sound to try is NC RF.1.4.a and RF.1.4.b, and the two-syllable words here (cereal, circus, giraffe) reach into RF.1.4.e.
tip: If e, i or y comes right after the c or g, try the soft sound first (s or j); otherwise go hard (k or g), then check it makes a real word.

cards.q: Hard c sounds like the k in kite. Which word has a hard c?
cards.sayQ: Hard C sounds like the K in kite. Which word has a hard C?
cards.note: cold: the c says k, like in cat. That is a hard c. In city and cereal the c is soft and says s.

cards.q: Soft c sounds like the s in sun. Which word has a soft c?
cards.sayQ: Soft C sounds like the S in sun. Which word has a soft C?
cards.note: circus: the first c says s, like in sun. That is a soft c, because i comes after it. The second c says k. cap and cow have a hard c.

cards.q: Hard g sounds like the g in gum. Which word has a hard g?
cards.sayQ: Hard G sounds like the G in gum. Which word has a hard G?
cards.note: goat: the g says guh, like in gum. That is a hard g. gentle and giraffe have a soft g that says j.

cards.q: Soft g sounds like the j in jam. Which word has a soft g?
cards.sayQ: Soft G sounds like the J in jam. Which word has a soft G?
cards.note: giraffe: the g says j, like in jam. That is a soft g, because i comes after it. gate and gas have a hard g.

cards.q: Is the c in cereal hard or soft?
cards.sayQ: Is the C in cereal hard or soft?
cards.note: cereal: c-e. The c says s, so it is a soft c. There is no g in cereal.

cards.q: Is the c in corn hard or soft?
cards.sayQ: Is the C in corn hard or soft?
cards.note: corn: c-o. The c says k, so it is a hard c.

cards.q: Listen to the word celery. Is its c hard or soft?
cards.sayQ: Listen to the word celery. Is its C hard or soft?
cards.note: celery: c-e. The c says s, so it is a soft c. An e after c makes it soft.

cards.q: Listen to the word cake. Is its c hard or soft?
cards.sayQ: Listen to the word cake. Is its C hard or soft?
cards.note: cake: c-a. The c says k, so it is a hard c. An a after c keeps it hard.

cards.q: Is the g in ginger hard or soft?
cards.sayQ: Is the G in ginger hard or soft?
cards.note: ginger: g-i. The g says j, so it is a soft g. Both g's in ginger say j. Ginger is the spice in gingerbread.

cards.q: Is the g in gold hard or soft?
cards.sayQ: Is the G in gold hard or soft?
cards.note: gold: g-o. The g says guh, so it is a hard g.

cards.q: Hard g says /g/. Soft g says /j/. Which does gym have?
cards.sayQ: Hard G says guh. Soft G says juh. Which does gym have?
cards.note: gym: g-y. The g says j, so it is a soft g. A y after g makes it soft, just like e and i do.

cards.q: Hard g says /g/. Soft g says /j/. Which does game have?
cards.sayQ: Hard G says guh. Soft G says juh. Which does game have?
cards.note: game: g-a. The g says guh, so it is a hard g.

cards.q: Hard c says /k/. Soft c says /s/. Which does cent have?
cards.sayQ: Hard C says kuh. Soft C says sss. Which does cent have?
cards.note: cent: c-e. The c says s, so it is a soft c. One cent is a penny.

cards.q: Hard c says /k/. Soft c says /s/. Which does cub have?
cards.sayQ: Hard C says kuh. Soft C says sss. Which does cub have?
cards.note: cub: c-u. The c says k, so it is a hard c. A cub is a baby bear.

cards.q: Which letter after c makes it soft, like in city?
cards.sayQ: Which letter after C makes it soft, like in city?
cards.note: c-i, c-e and c-y are soft: city, cent, cereal. c-a, c-o and c-u stay hard: cat, cot, cup.

cards.q: Which word has a soft g, the j sound?
cards.sayQ: Which word has a soft G, the J sound?
cards.note: gentle: g-e. The g says j, so it is a soft g. gum and goal have a hard g.

cards.q: Which letter after g makes it soft, like in gem?
cards.sayQ: Which letter after G makes it soft, like in gem?
cards.note: g-e, g-i and g-y are soft: gem, giant, gym. g-a, g-o and g-u stay hard: gate, goat, gum.
